actions.description: Added showinfo filter to ffmpeg scene frame extraction, parse pts_time from stderr for traceable timecode (never None). Updated resume path with _timestamps.json cache. Fixed build_visual_batches to distribute scene frames by timecode across all batches.
Added normalize_provider_response(): clamps null/negative start/end, strips text, drops empty segments, re-indexes, supplies _engine/_model markers. Every Groq payload normalizes before cache writes.

Added normalize_provider_response() call at each cache-write boundary: single-shot path, chunk path, and _persist_single_shot. Provider output normalizes before raw response store, manifest, and downstream subtitle artifacts.

8 focused tests: 6 for normalize_provider_response contract (null times, empty segments, missing segments, provider markers, end>=start, text stripping) + 2 for scene frame timecode contract (build_visual_batches distributes scene frames by time, extract_scene_frames never returns time=null with mocked ffmpeg)
pytest tests/ — 51 passed, 0 failed (8 new + 43 existing all passing)
